tasks.title: Add stage-state persistence service
tasks.description: Create the durable current-state model for stage tasks, checks, and approval state keyed by issue and stage. Add the database migration, repository, normalized status types, backend-owned static task definitions, and service methods to ensure stages and upsert current task/check state without changing execution history behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Database migration creates current-state storage for stages, tasks, and checks with uniqueness by issue, stage, and task/check identity
StageStateService can ensure a stage, seed backend task definitions, upsert a task, upsert a check, and read all stage states for an issue
Task and check status normalization is implemented in one backend boundary rather than in API routes or UI components
Existing stage_executions schema and repository behavior remain available for audit history
Relevant unit tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the service interface narrow: callers should not need to know whether state came from new rows, seeded definitions, or legacy projection.

tasks.title: Expose unified stage-state API
tasks.description: Add the issue stage-state API endpoint backed by StageStateService and return the normalized shape needed by Issue Detail. Rework `/tasks` and `/build-status` only as compatibility projections or leave them intact, but ensure the new endpoint is the authoritative read path for current task/check progress.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/stage-state returns all available stage states for the issue with tasks, checks, approval, status, and updatedAt fields
The endpoint returns normalized task statuses and normalized check statuses without exposing tasks.json passes or CheckResult pass/fail variants
Missing current-state rows are handled by StageStateService lazy seeding or projection instead of returning contradictory empty data
GET /api/issues/:number/executions still returns execution history for audit consumers
API tests or route-level tests cover the new response shape and a not-found issue case
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not make API routes aggregate raw tasks.json, check_suites, and stage_executions directly; keep that complexity behind StageStateService.

tasks.title: Mirror runner progress into stage state
tasks.description: Wire StageStateService into stage execution so plan, build, check, integrate, and fix task progress update current stage entities in place. Preserve the existing stage_executions audit writes while making task and check retries update the same current task/check identity.
acceptanceCriteria: BaseStageRunner ensures current stage state when a stage attempt starts while still creating a stage_executions row
Task result recording writes both the audit snapshot and the current stage task row
Check result recording writes both the audit snapshot and the current stage check row
Repeated fix/check attempts update attempts or run counts on the current row rather than requiring UI aggregation across executions
Build tasks generated from tasks.json are mirrored into normalized stage task state without removing tasks.json artifact compatibility
Existing plan/build/check/integrate flow tests continue to pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Current-state writes should be best-effort logged like existing audit writes, but failures must not silently corrupt stage_executions history.

tasks.title: Add frontend stage-state client model
tasks.description: Add frontend TypeScript types, API client method, and React Query hook for the unified stage-state endpoint. The hook should be the shared data source that Issue Detail components use for task/check progress refreshes.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend types represent normalized StageState, StageTaskState, StageCheckState, and approval state returned by the backend endpoint
api.getIssueStageState calls GET /api/issues/:number/stage-state and returns typed data
useIssueStageState exists with a stable React Query key and polling or invalidation behavior appropriate for live progress
No Issue Detail component is required to call the new endpoint manually outside the shared hook
Frontend typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep status conversion out of frontend types; the backend response should already be normalized.

tasks.title: Migrate Issue Detail progress UI
tasks.description: Update PipelineView and TaskProgressPanel so both render task/check progress from the unified stage-state hook. Remove frontend hardcoded stage task definitions as the source of truth and stop using execution lookup for primary current-state rendering.
acceptanceCriteria: PipelineView renders tasks and checks from stage-state data instead of executions.find for current task/check status
TaskProgressPanel renders the same normalized stage task data as PipelineView and no longer prefers /build-status or /tasks as its primary data source
PLAN_TASK_DEFS, CHECK_TASK_DEFS, and INTEGRATE_TASK_DEFS are removed from frontend current-state rendering
Dynamic tasks such as fix-check-health render when present in stage-state data even if they are not static backend definitions
Execution history remains available only for explicit audit/debug usage if still rendered
Frontend typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The visual behavior can stay close to the existing UI; the important outcome is a single current-state source.

tasks.title: Add stage-state regression coverage
tasks.description: Add targeted regression tests for the contradictory-state cases that motivated this change. Cover multiple stage executions, dynamic fix tasks, normalized status mapping, and frontend consistency between PipelineView and TaskProgressPanel.
acceptanceCriteria: A backend test proves multiple executions for the same issue and stage resolve to the latest current task/check state without reading only the first execution
A backend test proves dynamic fix tasks are included in stage-state output
A backend test proves tasks.json build task state is projected or mirrored into normalized stage-state task rows
A frontend test proves PipelineView and TaskProgressPanel consume the same stage-state data for task progress
Relevant test suites pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use small fixtures that model issue #156/#163 symptoms: repeated executions and contradictory old data sources.
